the style: flash from the wall, or custom
a cover-up of an old tattoo, or new skin
for a big piece: a consult first

for the mobile studio: where it can park, and the owner's OK
secure_page_only: 18 or older, and a photo ID will be shown at the studio
the consent and release form, signed for every session
blood thinners or a bleeding problem

intake_questions.who_may_book: adults only: an adult books a tattoo or a piercing for themselves, and shows a photo ID showing 18 or older at every session; nobody under 18 is booked (the studio's own rule, and the state's where it's stricter)

stop.words: trouble breathing, or a swollen face, lips or throat after a tattoo or piercing
a high fever, or red streaks spreading from a new tattoo or piercing
stop.say: See a doctor today. If it's hard to breathe, call 911.
stop.booking: no booking until a doctor says it's OK

go_on.words: a red, sore or itchy new tattoo with no fever
go_on.what: wash it gently with mild soap and water; the artist answers on the secure page; see a doctor if a fever starts

go_on.words: a sunburn, rash, cut or infection at the spot before a session
go_on.what: the spot is never tattooed; the artist checks it first, and the session moves at no fee

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking; Rosie and the AI never give health advice

steps.name: Consent and health form
steps.when: before every session, on the secure page (or on the studio's tablet at check-in)
steps.who: everyone, for every tattoo and piercing
steps.result: any yes on the health questions goes to the artist to read before the session; the artist OKs it, calls first, or calls it off with a full refund

steps.name: Free consult
steps.when: before a big or custom piece, at least 2 days before the session, at the studio
steps.who: half sleeves, cover-ups and big custom pieces
steps.result: the placement, size and plan; the artist sets the price, and the customer says yes or cancels with a full refund

steps.name: Design shared before the session
steps.when: 1 or 2 days before a custom session, on the secure page
steps.who: custom pieces (flash is already on the wall)
steps.result: the customer replies looks right, or asks for changes; changes or no reply never cancel: the artist settles them at the start of the session, before any stencil

steps.name: Event or mobile studio permit
steps.when: before a guest spot, an event or a mobile studio visit, where the state's rules require it
steps.result: on file before the day, or the visit moves

first_steps_and_forms.prep: for the confirmation and the reminder: bring a photo ID; eat beforehand; no alcohol or drugs for 24 hours before; keep the spot out of the sun; wear clothes that leave the spot easy to reach

staff.skills: custom work, flash, lettering, cover-ups, piercing; only the artist who drew a custom piece is offered for it
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each artist's and piercer's license per state, where the state's form says so
staff.supervision: apprentices work only under a licensed artist, where the state's rules allow
staff.who_oks: Sam OKs every custom quote, a past ink reaction, and same-day or new-customer bookings he set to ask first
staff.stand_in: a custom piece stays with its artist: if they're out, only their next dates are offered; flash and piercing can go to another artist with the skill

children_and_age.who_may_book: adults only: an adult books a tattoo or a piercing for themselves, and shows a photo ID showing 18 or older at every session; nobody under 18 is booked (the studio's own rule, and the state's where it's stricter)
children_and_age.minors_texts: nobody under 18 is booked, so no text goes to a parent about a child

visit.check_in: the check-in code at the front desk; in the mobile studio, at the door of the customer's place
visit.done: before any work, every session: a photo ID showing 18 or older, the person sober, and the consent form signed (an unsigned one is signed on the studio's tablet first); no ID, or impaired: no tattoo today, and the owner decides about the deposit
visit.changes_at_visit: a design change, more time or a small add-on is priced and OK'd before it's done; by the hour, the time used is billed
visit.before_work: the artist checks the skin at the spot, places the stencil, and the customer OKs it in the mirror before the first line

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: always: tattooing and body piercing are licensed where the state's rules require it (a switch from the state form)
license.who: both, as the state's form says: the studio holds an establishment license or health permit, and each artist and piercer holds their own license or registration
license.ask: the studio's license or permit number; each artist's number in their invite reply (or the owner sends it)
license.insurance: liability insurance where the state's form or a venue asks for it

never_in_a_text: health answers, health questions, healing photos, reference images and ID details never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the customer's record; the artist answers health questions in their own words on the secure page
